recheck: Round 2 text preserved; Temporal current dispositions reconciled to R16 follow-up extension. R14 external review remains 6.0 / Accept; R16 is not externally rescored.

read.zh: Round 2 明确推荐接收；现在应守住 pre-context / exact-support scope，不为扩大普适性重开主线。
read.en: Round 2 recommends acceptance; preserve the pre-context/exact-support scope rather than reopening the main line for breadth.

next.zh: 只做低成本 scalability / support-misspecification 离线分析，其余保持 scope boundary。
next.en: Only low-cost scalability/support-misspecification analysis is worth doing now; keep the rest as scope boundaries.

why.zh: 当前 certificate 明确是 pre-context；扩到 query-conditioned routing 是新 scientific object。
why.en: The certificate is explicitly pre-context; query-conditioned routing is a new scientific object.

why.zh: 已有 frozen matrices 与 box/max-share 变体，可零新调用做误标敏感性。
why.en: Frozen matrices and box/max-share variants permit zero-call misspecification analysis.

why.zh: SkillRL 只能作 identity-sensitivity witness，不能升级为 R* certificate。
why.en: SkillRL remains an identity-sensitivity witness and cannot be upgraded into an R* certificate.

why.zh: 当前只支持 bounded P19 behavior chain，不支持 prevalence/general effect size。
why.en: Current evidence supports only the bounded P19 behavior chain, not prevalence or general effect size.

why.zh: 可用 synthetic sparse matrices 做纯计算 runtime/memory profiling。
why.en: Synthetic sparse matrices permit pure computational runtime/memory profiling.

why.zh: r4 已 42-work novelty attack、KEEP_NARROW、9/9 CI；不再卖 LP/cone 本身新颖性。
why.en: r4 binds the 42-work novelty attack, KEEP_NARROW, and 9/9 CI; LP/cone machinery is no longer sold as the novelty.

read.zh: write-time intervention 仍被认可；压力集中在 novelty 收窄、语义诊断、heterogeneity 与 no-memory。
read.en: The write-time intervention remains well received; pressure is on narrower novelty, semantic diagnostics, heterogeneity, and no-memory.

next.zh: 先补 semantic/strategy diagnostics 与 4×4 heterogeneity；未来若 reopen，新实验首选 no-memory terminal arm。
next.en: First add semantic/strategy diagnostics and 4×4 heterogeneity; if reopened, prioritize a no-memory terminal arm.

topic.zh: 与 memory/reward 近邻工作的 novelty boundary
topic.en: novelty boundary versus memory/reward prior work

why.zh: r4 已改标题并收窄到 identical-trajectory reward-conditioned writer-branch persistent-state intervention。
why.en: r4 retitles and narrows the claim to the identical-trajectory reward-conditioned writer-branch persistent-state intervention.

topic.zh: Jaccard 之外的语义/结构诊断

why.zh: 四个 complete paired memories 已冻结，可离线做 strategy/topic/structural-slot 分析。
why.en: Four complete paired memories are frozen and can support offline strategy/topic/structural-slot analysis.

why.zh: GET-only 恢复仍无 assistant text；F0 只能对 4 个 complete pairs 条件成立，不能重 POST 救样本。
why.en: GET-only recovery still has no assistant text; F0 stays conditional on four complete pairs and should not be rescued by re-POSTing.

why.zh: 完整 frozen matrix 可分析 source-future similarity、task structure、retrieval relevance 与 effect concentration。
why.en: The frozen matrix supports offline analysis of source-future similarity, task structure, retrieval relevance, and effect concentration.

why.zh: 这是新 treatment，会产生新 terminal outcomes；现有两臂不能推出。
why.en: This is a new treatment producing new terminal outcomes and cannot be inferred from the two existing arms.

reopen.zh: 冻结 no-memory contract + 独立 units + 明确 scientific/experiment authority。
reopen.en: Freeze the no-memory contract, independent units, and explicit scientific/experiment authority.

topic.zh: 跨模型 / live loop / corruption sweep

why.zh: 都会改变模型、环境或 corruption process，属于新 scientific execution。
why.en: These change models, environments, or the corruption process and are new scientific execution.

reopen.zh: 新模型/环境/corruption process 必须形成独立 preregistration、fresh units 与新的 scientific/experiment authority。
reopen.en: Any new model/environment/corruption process requires an independent preregistration, fresh units, and new scientific/experiment authority.

read.zh: Round 2 历史 verdict 为 Weak Accept；R14 post-repair 外审为 6.0 / Accept。当前 R16 进一步加入 benign generic、fresh EIA/BLS 与 multi-turn/Fed follow-up，但尚未重新外审；核心 scientific contract 不变。
read.en: The historical Round-2 verdict is Weak Accept and the R14 post-repair review is 6.0 / Accept. Current R16 adds benign-generic, fresh EIA/BLS, and multi-turn/Fed follow-up evidence but has not been externally rescored; the core scientific contract is unchanged.

next.zh: 不再扩实验：fresh EIA/BLS 作为 appendix robustness；multi-turn 无 callable residual；planning/deliberation spin-off 被 prospectively frozen Fed null 停止。
next.en: Do not expand experiments further: fresh EIA/BLS are appendix robustness evidence; multi-turn shows no callable residual; the planning/deliberation spin-off is stopped by the prospectively frozen Fed null.

topic.zh: skill attribution / temporal RAG novelty boundary

why.zh: r8 已收窄为 procedure-bottleneck identification，并明确不声称 skill wrapper 优于等价 retrieval-side implementation。
why.en: r8 narrows to procedure-bottleneck identification and explicitly disclaims skill-wrapper superiority over an equivalent retrieval-side implementation.

topic.en: invocation rate, prompt length, condition position

why.zh: canonical r9 zero-call audit：targeted/generic 皆 442/442 强制一次，no-skill 0/442；各臂 position p>.65；targeted prompt 平均短 18.85 tokens。
why.en: Canonical r9 zero-call audit: targeted/generic are forced once in 442/442 rows each, no-skill 0/442; position p>.65 in every arm; targeted prompts average 18.85 tokens shorter.

why.zh: canonical r10 零调用静态审计覆盖 35 个 frozen endpoint：55 个 cutoff_date 与 176 个 release_date 均为合法 YYYY-MM-DD；88/88 个实际 T1 release≤cutoff 比较与 parsed-calendar 顺序一致，0 mismatch。
why.en: Canonical r10 zero-call static audit covers all 35 frozen endpoints: all 55 cutoff_date and 176 release_date fields are valid YYYY-MM-DD values, and all 88 observed T1 release<=cutoff comparisons agree with parsed-calendar ordering with zero mismatches.

why.zh: R14 已执行 same-surface no-op G₀。结果反而证明 full-track neutrality 不能自动运输到每个 stratum，因此论文把 G₀ 改成 placebo/surface diagnostic，并把 T−G₀ 与 G₀−N 分开；当前 claim 不再依赖“behavior-neutral generic”假设。
why.en: R14 executes same-surface no-op G0. The result shows full-track neutrality does not automatically transport to every stratum, so G0 is reframed as a placebo/surface diagnostic and T−G0 is kept separate from G0−N; the current claim no longer depends on a behavior-neutral-generic assumption.

objections.e: R14 G0 A1/A2/Kimi + R16 benign-organizer EIA/BLS follow-up

why.zh: R14 Rsurf 只识别 forced one-answer exact-output placement；R16 又执行真实 multi-turn function-call fork，但 BASE/CONTEXT/TOOL 均 4/4、TOOL 调用 2/4 且 TOOL−CONTEXT=0。仍没有独立 temporal retriever equivalence/superiority 证据，因此该 claim 继续作为永久边界。
why.en: R14 Rsurf only identifies forced one-answer exact-output placement. R16 additionally runs a real multi-turn function-call fork, but BASE/CONTEXT/TOOL are all 4/4, TOOL is invoked on 2/4, and TOOL−CONTEXT=0. There is still no independent temporal-retriever equivalence/superiority evidence, so that claim remains a permanent boundary.

objections.e: R14 Rsurf + R16 real function-call multi-turn null

reopen.zh: 只有未来要主张 temporal-retrieval equivalence / superiority 时，才需要同 raw candidates 的独立 retriever/reranker。
reopen.en: Only a future temporal-retrieval equivalence/superiority claim requires an independent retriever/reranker over the same raw candidates.

topic.en: small grounding/alignment endpoint counts and limited cross-domain breadth

why.zh: R16 新增 fresh EIA 与 BLS 各 4 个 endpoint，仍然低分辨率；它们用于 robustness/boundary，而不是把 endpoint-level 结果升级成一般跨域 effect size。Fed planning prospectively frozen 对照为 25% vs 25%。
why.en: R16 adds four fresh EIA and four BLS endpoints, still low-resolution; they are robustness/boundary evidence rather than a general cross-domain effect-size claim. The prospectively frozen Fed planning comparison is 25% vs 25%.

topic.zh: availability 与 endogenous use 区分

why.zh: canonical r9 source audit 证明 helper 是 frozen harness 强制执行一次，不是 agent 自主 tool-use；调用率误读已关闭。
why.en: Canonical r9 source audit shows the helper is forced once by the frozen harness rather than invoked endogenously by the agent, closing the call-rate ambiguity.

read.zh: 问题仍是 measurement credibility / small-N / missing controls；r7 已完成所有 existing-evidence paper-only 修复，同时没有伪造 human、second judge、NullMemory 或更长 horizon。
read.en: Measurement credibility, small N, and missing controls remain the core boundary; r7 closes the existing-evidence paper-only repairs without fabricating human, second-judge, NullMemory, or longer-horizon evidence.

next.zh: O3/O4 已由 r7 离线证据修复闭合；后续只在 human/second judge/threshold、NullMemory、longer horizon/backbone 获得 scientific reopen 时继续。
next.en: R7 closes O3/O4 with offline evidence; further work now requires scientific reopen for human/second-judge/threshold calibration, NullMemory, or longer-horizon/backbone evidence.

why.zh: r6 恢复 exact journals，记录 raw=4、action-attempt-aligned=3、reverted=2，并保持 primary 8/12 vs 4/12 不变。
why.en: r6 recovers exact journals, records raw=4, action-attempt-aligned=3, reverted=2, and leaves the primary 8/12 versus 4/12 unchanged.

topic.en: HarmBench is not a noiseless oracle

why.zh: r6 Claim Audit 明确 harmbench_oracle_not_claimed=true；所有结论只针对 frozen operational evaluator。
why.en: r6 Claim Audit records harmbench_oracle_not_claimed=true; all claims stay tied to the frozen operational evaluator.

topic.zh: qualitative violations / selection / decoding 说明

why.zh: r7 将 exact-journal 离线分析写入正文：公开结构化 qualitative taxonomy（不暴露有害内容）、四个 pre-existing state/12 branch 的冻结时序、branch seeds、无 outcome-driven replacement，以及 Qwen/HarmBench decoding/randomness 边界。
why.en: R7 writes the exact-journal offline analysis into the manuscript: a structural qualitative taxonomy without unsafe text, frozen timing for the four pre-existing states and 12 branches, branch seeds and no outcome-driven replacement, plus Qwen/HarmBench decoding and randomness boundaries.

objections.e: G1 r7 Stanford-round2 robustness receipt / Claim Audit 22/22

why.zh: r7 对 primary 4–0 discordance 增加 exact paired calibration：two-sided p=.125、one-sided p=.0625，并明确 branch 嵌套 state、non-IID、只作 small-n sensitivity，不升级 population effect。
why.en: R7 adds exact paired calibration for the primary 4–0 discordance: two-sided p=.125 and one-sided p=.0625, while explicitly retaining state clustering, non-IID scope, and small-n sensitivity rather than a population-effect upgrade.

objections.e: G1 r7 round2 evidence / paper-preparation r7

why.zh: r6：human packet 未标注且未用于 claims；threshold sweep 无 continuous score；第二 judge 是新 evaluator execution。
why.en: r6: human packet is unlabeled and unused; threshold sweep lacks continuous scores; a second judge is new evaluator execution.

reopen.zh: 预先冻结 blinded human/second-judge 或 continuous-score threshold protocol，并获得独立 evaluator execution authority；现有 unlabeled packet 不足以重开。
reopen.en: Pre-freeze a blinded human/second-judge or continuous-score threshold protocol and obtain independent evaluator-execution authority; the current unlabeled packet is insufficient.

why.zh: base-workflow freeze 只识别 update-associated contrast；NullMemory 是新 treatment 和新 trajectories。
why.en: The base-workflow freeze identifies only an update-associated contrast; NullMemory is a new treatment with new trajectories.

reopen.zh: 冻结 NullMemory/read-disabled treatment、同 schedule 配对 units 与新 trajectory budget，并重新通过 scientific/experiment gate。
reopen.en: Freeze the NullMemory/read-disabled treatment, same-schedule paired units, and a new trajectory budget, then pass scientific/experiment gates.

topic.zh: 更长 horizon / 更多 backbone-memory

why.zh: 这是新 substrate/generalization，不是当前 manuscript repair；必须 fresh preregistration，禁止 horizon/guard shopping。
why.en: This is new substrate/generalization work, not manuscript repair; it needs fresh preregistration and forbids horizon/guard shopping.

reopen.zh: 使用 fresh preregistered states/backbone-memory substrate 与预先冻结 horizon；不得依据已暴露结果选择 horizon/guard。
reopen.en: Use fresh preregistered states/backbone-memory substrates with a prospectively frozen horizon; do not choose horizons/guards from exposed outcomes.

read.zh: Round 2 对 L0–L3 与 causal sign unresolved 的判断仍成立。R19 已获得 bounded execution authority，benchmark 前 support/synthetic gates 均通过；当前在完整 task boundary 停于 24/140 episodes、6/35 independent tasks，未计算任何 interim effect、p-value 或区间。与此同时，论文闭环方法 PSMG 已作为 pre-outcome design 冻结：provenance 留在 memory manager 侧用于治理，executor 只接收治理后的 content；该方法尚无新增 treatment execution authority。
read.en: Round 2 remains correct about L0-L3 and the unresolved causal sign. R19 has bounded execution authority and passed the prebenchmark support/synthetic gates; it is checkpointed at a complete task boundary with 24/140 episodes and 6/35 independent tasks, with no interim effect, p-value, or interval computed. In parallel, the paper-closing PSMG response is frozen as a pre-outcome design: provenance stays in the memory-manager control plane while the executor receives only governed content; no new treatment execution is authorized.

next.zh: R19 只允许从 frozen sequence 24 继续；保持 cohort、R17 memory bytes、model manifest、endpoint、预算和统计判据不变。140/140 完整前禁止 effect/p-value/claim 更新。PSMG 目前只作为“现象→识别→治理”闭环方法设计；只有 R19 完整裁决后，才允许单独申请新的 fresh-unit mitigation experiment。O6 financial L3 仍独立 support-blocked。
next.en: R19 may resume only from frozen sequence 24 with the cohort, R17 memory bytes, model manifest, endpoint, budgets, and statistical rule unchanged. No effect, p-value, or claim update is allowed before 140/140 completion. PSMG is currently a paper-closing phenomenon-to-identification-to-governance design only; any fresh-unit mitigation experiment requires a separate authorization after full R19 adjudication. O6 financial L3 remains independently support-blocked.

why.zh: 当前标题直接写 causal sign unresolved，L0 observational、L1 writer bundle、L2 metadata-only、L3 transport 已分开。
why.en: The current title states that the causal sign is unresolved, and L0 observational, L1 writer bundle, L2 metadata-only, and L3 transport are separated.

topic.zh: terminal n=4 的 p-value resolution floor

why.zh: Δ=+0.1667,p=.0785 只能是 directional evidence；seed replication 不能替代 task units 或改 gate。
why.en: Δ=+0.1667,p=.0785 remains directional evidence; seed replication cannot replace task units or alter the gate.

why.zh: r7 明确把 |Δ|≥.15 定位为 practical-relevance floor，而非 power 保证；增加前瞻 80% power 规划：task-level SD=.20/.30/.40 时 one-sided 约需 11/25/44 个独立 tasks（two-sided 14/32/56），并冻结 future confirmatory 的 task-unit / stopping / interval contract。
why.en: R7 explicitly treats |Δ|≥.15 as a practical-relevance floor rather than a power guarantee and adds prospective 80% power planning: task-level SD=.20/.30/.40 requires about 11/25/44 independent tasks one-sided (14/32/56 two-sided), with task-unit, stopping, and interval reporting frozen for any future confirmatory run.

why.zh: r7 零调用 re-threshold 显示 R4 的 4/4 admitted pairs 在 cosine .85/.90 仍保持，但已有 stronger-verifier audit 仅 0/4 与 1/4 fully equivalent；确定性 lexical audit 又显示 failure writer 在 R6 中 23/24 更 caution、20/24 更 verification、20/24 更 directive。结果不是把 L1 变得更强，而是明确把它限制为含 style/strategy asymmetry 的 writer-bundle。
why.en: R7 zero-call re-thresholding keeps all 4/4 R4 admitted pairs at cosine .85/.90, but the archived stronger-verifier audit finds only 0/4 and 1/4 fully equivalent; deterministic lexical diagnostics also find the failure writer more caution-heavy in 23/24 R6 pairs, more verification-heavy in 20/24, and more directive in 20/24. This does not strengthen a provenance-only claim; it explicitly limits L1 to a writer bundle with residual style/strategy asymmetry.

objections.e: B1 r7 operational-equivalence stress / Paper Preparation 8/8

why.zh: 历史 R5 5/10 support stop 与 6-task generic explicit-cue bridge 均保持原裁决，不能与后续对象拼接。R9–R15 已闭合 native status、cohort、runtime、live Shopping、writer/executor/analysis contract；R17 在下游 outcome 之前统一生成并冻结 36/36 exact memory bytes。R18a/R18b 是零科学暴露的 support failure；R18c 则在 agent action 已发生后、原生 terminal evaluator 给出有效 score 之前因 hard-coded evaluator model alias 缺失而失败。依据 R15/R16 的 post-exposure no-retry 与 single-attempt 规则，R18 必须 STOP；该失败不是 scientific negative，cum_reward=0 也不得当作 terminal score。
why.en: Historical R5 (5/10 support stop) and the six-task generic explicit-cue bridge retain their original adjudications and cannot be pooled with later objects. R9–R15 close the native-status, cohort, runtime, live-Shopping, writer/executor, and analysis contracts; R17 uniformly realizes and freezes exact memory bytes for 36/36 sources before downstream outcomes. R18a/R18b are zero-scientific-exposure support failures. R18c fails after an agent action but before a valid native terminal evaluator score because the evaluator hard-coded model alias is absent. Under the R15/R16 post-exposure no-retry and single-attempt rules, R18 must STOP. This is not scientific negative evidence, and cum_reward=0 is not a terminal score.

reopen.zh: R19 已作为新的 scientific object 获得 bounded execution authority；不得 retry R18。继续时只能从 frozen sequence 12 恢复，复用 R17 exact memory bytes，不改 task/model/endpoint/threshold/statistics。只有 140/140 valid terminal episodes 完整后才执行冻结的 task-level two-sided sign-flip；完整但不过联合 gate 仍是 INCONCLUSIVE_NO_NO_EFFECT_AUTHORITY；STARTED 后 support failure 则 NO_VERDICT 且禁止 retry。
reopen.en: R19 has bounded execution authority as a new scientific object; R18 remains non-retriable. Execution may resume only from frozen sequence 12, reusing the exact R17 memory bytes with no task/model/endpoint/threshold/statistical change. The frozen task-level two-sided sign-flip analysis runs only after 140/140 valid terminal episodes. A complete run that misses the joint gate remains INCONCLUSIVE_NO_NO_EFFECT_AUTHORITY; a support failure after STARTED yields NO_VERDICT with no retry.

objections.e: B1 R22/R28 public execution status: R19 bounded authority valid; support gates PASS; 24/140 at complete task boundary; no interim inference; PSMG closure method frozen pre-outcome

method_closure_plan.story: phenomenon -> causal identification -> provenance-separated governance -> bounded validation

why.zh: 2026-08-24 fresh public release-surface recheck 仍只观察到 arXiv v1（2026-08-18）；源论文结论仍明确声明 code and audit artifacts 将在 publication 后发布。按 exact title、arXiv ID、作者/ORCID 对 GitHub 与 Hugging Face 做 bounded discovery，仍未发现可核验的 first-party financial per-query ReasoningBank/audit bundle。第三方 Request Code 页面不算发布证据，ORCID 的 JS-only 页面也不作为不存在的负证据。因此 O6 继续是 support + experiment debt，而非 scientific negative。
why.en: A fresh public release-surface recheck on 2026-08-24 still observes only arXiv v1 (2026-08-18); the source paper conclusion still states that code and audit artifacts will be released upon publication. Bounded discovery over the exact title, arXiv ID, and author/ORCID queries on GitHub and Hugging Face finds no verifiable first-party financial per-query ReasoningBank/audit bundle. Third-party Request Code pages do not count as release evidence, and JavaScript-only ORCID pages are not treated as negative evidence. O6 therefore remains support plus experiment debt rather than a scientific negative.

reopen.zh: 恢复可执行的 source-faithful financial runtime/provenance intervention surface，预先冻结 transport estimand 与独立 units，并重新通过 scientific/experiment gate。
reopen.en: Restore an executable source-faithful financial runtime/provenance intervention surface, pre-freeze the transport estimand and independent units, and pass scientific/experiment gates.

why.zh: R6 Δ=-0.0942 不是 terminal-success surrogate，且与 terminal directional sign 相反；两个 rung 不聚合，causal sign 持续 unresolved。
why.en: R6 Δ=-0.0942 is not a terminal-success surrogate and points opposite the terminal directional sign; rungs are not aggregated and the causal sign remains unresolved.
